verdict.rationale: SendGrid documents an Event Webhook that posts email event data to a URL the developer controls, which covers receiving event data programmatically. Its Deliverability Insights is an in-app dashboard, not a per-message API. Nothing in the evidence documents an API for querying a single message's event history, and open/click tracking is not named specifically. missing for 10: an API endpoint to query per-message event history, explicit open and click tracking documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can track opens and clicks and query a per-message event history via the API to answer 'what happened to this email?'

citations.quote: To have Twilio SendGrid post email event data to a URL you control, add and configure an Event Webhook.
